groups.name: core
groups.why: nRF52832 with its VDD decaps (C4, C7), DEC1/DEC3 caps, its DC-DC (L2, L3, C2 on DEC4), its RF match (C10, L1) to the U.FL AE1, its 32 MHz crystal, the SWD pogo pads SC1 on the back, the LSM6DS3 IMU on its SPI bus, and the two sense dividers read by its ADC pins (battery level R19/R20/C20, NTC R22/R23/C22)

templates.why: nRF52832: its ANT pin's matching network (C10 shunt, L1 series) to the U.FL, and in the same template its built-in DC-DC (DCC -> L2 10uH -> L3 15nH -> DEC4 with C2); one chip, one template, from Nordic's reference layout

groups.name: ui
groups.why: the RGB status LED and its three 2k cathode resistors, driven from U1 P0.06-P0.08

groups.name: power_in
groups.why: micro-USB charge input: VBUS cap C17, the TP4054 Li-ion charger U4 with its PROG resistor R18 and charge LED D4/R16; the battery pads J5 (+, through the PTC fuse F1) and J6 (GND) and the slide power switch SW2 between the battery and +4V. J2 and SW2 are declared on the north edge

groups.name: power
groups.why: the soft power latch: button SW1 and MCU SYS_ON ORed by U3 into the SIP32510 load switch IC3 (+4V -> +BATT), the BT_OUT sense divider R17/R21 to U1, and the 3.3 V LDO U6 (+BATT -> +3V3) with its input cap C18 and output caps C14 / C5

groups.name: adc
groups.why: the MCP3911 ADC with its REFIN+ cap C15 and RESET pull-up R15, the GND-GNDA net tie GC1 at it, its analog supply: LDO U5 (+BATT -> +3.3VADC, ground GNDA) with input cap C21 and output caps C9/C16/C19, and the load switch IC4 (+3.3VADC -> +3.3VA for the amplifiers, EN from U1). Inside the GNDA pour

groups.name: afe
groups.why: the ECG electrode front end: E+ (E+1, fixed) through R4 to the follower U9 with its 40M bias chain R11-R14 to +3.3VA, AC-coupled by C6/R6 into CH0+/CH1+, R8/C11 across CH1+/CH0-, the BAV99 clamps D1/D3; E- reaches CH0- through R9; U8 buffers the R2/R3/C8 bias divider into CH0- through R1. Inside the GNDA pour
